notes.title: Kobold TF update build 1
notes.content:
So, I have added kobold TF from the now edible kobold eggs, harpy eggs are also updated to do likewise.

I will be adding more updates later, including more tf items, more quests, characters, and events,

but it has been a while since anything has been updated, so I'm updating this now, and then working on everything as I can.

notes.title: asset corruption patch
notes.content:
replaced and removed corrupted assets causing crashes in the hermetic sanctum.
if you encounter any crashes, please report them and the error messages to the steam community official bug report thread. :3

notes.title: fixed some dialogue events with hostile creatures causing a crash.
notes.content: fixed some dialogue events with hostile creatures causing a crash. crash was reported for goblins, but the nature of the bug lead to a more simple fix to the dialogue step system that was causing the bug under certain circumstances, mainly some dialogues with only a close option did not properly link and would throw a nonexistent struct call. patched now, with an !is_undefined prior to the choice.run_code ^w^

notes.title: Update to new and known bugs (dec 19 2022)
notes.content: so I fixed livestock animals glitching out and spewing items when set on fire, as well as loot drop issues, some errors, and some crashes. Also added day/night to the scorching effects of the desert. book cases will drop the world map.
